items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: So fast as Albert cleaned one of them crabs

ctx.x: So you went in the train station and the reporter said what?

Here's a present from your friend. And here's a big bushel of crabs. I mean a bushel basket of crabs. And a case of beer. Now, can't nobody -- don't nobody know how to eat them crabs. Duke didn't know how to clean the crabs. Ivie didn't know nothing about cleaning those crabs. Barney knew and Toby knew. That's all. Man, we got to eating the crabs and drinking the beer. Now, this is about 3:00 o'clock in the morning. And man, Duke's standing up there with the rest of the band, he don't know what the hell to do…
have it and I'd look around and the guys, everybody got crabs but me. I said, "Oh, no, I ain't going no further."
